declarations.name: AuiToaster
declarations.description:
Angular service for Toast notifications:
`inject(AuiToaster).show({ tone: 'success', message: 'Saved' })`.
The toaster region is created lazily in the browser; on the server `show()`
returns null and renders nothing.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Show a toast; returns its handle (dismiss, update), or null on the server.

functions.name: provideAuiToaster
functions.description: Configure the application toaster (position, max, duration, hotkey).

constants.name: AUI_TOASTER_OPTIONS
constants.description: Toaster options token; set it with `provideAuiToaster`.
